Docs.summary: Represents a Skia Graphite GPU context, the entry point for GPU-accelerated rendering with the Graphite backend.
Docs.remarks: Create a context with one of the Create* factory methods for the Dawn, Metal, or Vulkan backend, then use to record drawing commands and and to play them back on the GPU.
